entries.title: Migration numbers follow ship order: identity 061; Phase C nominee 062, SIP 063, maturity 064
entries.text: migrate.ts applies every unapplied file by set membership in filename order, so gaps and late lower numbers run. Production would then apply them out of numeric order across releases. To keep production order equal to filename order, each lane takes the next free number when it lands. Phase A identity (A8 contact history) uses 061. The plan's Phase C reservations shift: C1 nominee 062, C2 admin SIP schedule 063, C3 maturity schedule 064. Reviews (E1) and bank reference (C-L3) take the next free numbers when built. Every new migration also updates the releaseUpgrade integration test's expected list.

entries.title: Migration numbers follow ship order: 061 identity, 062 investment email; Phase C nominee 063, SIP 064, maturity 065
entries.text:
migrate.ts applies every unapplied file by set membership in filename order, so gaps and late lower numbers do run. But production would then apply migrations out of numeric order across releases. To keep production order equal to filename order, each lane takes the next free number when it lands:
- 061: A8 contact history (on main)
- 062: B1 investment_recorded email template check (lane b-receipts)
- Phase C: C1 nominee 063, C2 admin SIP schedule 064, C3 maturity schedule 065
- Reviews (E1) and bank reference (C-L3) take the next free numbers when built.
Every new migration also adds itself to the releaseUpgrade integration test's expected list.

entries.title: Migration numbers: 061 identity, 062 investment email, 063 nominee, 064 SIP, 065 maturity, 066 audit index, 067 reviews
entries.text:
migrate.ts applies every unapplied file in filename order. To keep production order equal to filename order, numbers follow the plan's lanes:
- 061: A8 contact history (on main).
- 062: B1 investment_recorded email template check (on main).
- 063: C1 nominee (lane c-nominee).
- 064: C2 admin SIP schedules (lane c-sip).
- 065: C3 maturity schedule (maturity lane, after c-sip).
- 066: audit_events expression index on metadata userId for the per-client audit list (lane c-reports).
- 067: E1 client reviews (lane e-reviews).
- A bank reference on recordings (question row 16) and anything later take the next free number when built.
All of these ship in one release, so applying them out of order within it is harmless. Every new migration adds itself to the releaseUpgrade integration test's expected list; the coordinator merges the lists at landing. A migration that adds users columns must make earlier users-snapshot upgrade tests (userContactHistoryMigration) compare after their own migration only, as c-nominee did.
